nodes.title: Cell resistance 4.0 mOhm at 25 degC
nodes.text: DC internal resistance per cell of a new 4S 6500 hard-case pack
nodes.basis: hobby 6000-6500 mAh packs measure 2.5-5 mOhm/cell new; C-rating labels (130C) are not physical. Measure with a load step (T-E2-IR)

nodes.title: Pack lead, connector and harness 6.5 mOhm (mirror of params electrical.r_ext_mohm)
nodes.text: Series resistance between the cells and the ESC power pads, hot: F1's CL-F1-R-EXT via params electrical.r_ext_mohm (D-32)
nodes.basis: E2's own calcs read P:electrical.r_ext_mohm directly. This id is kept only for the calcs of other roles that still read it (E1 CALC-E1-WORST, E3, H1), so they re-run on 6.5 instead of the old 3 mOhm; it retires when they re-point to the parameter (CR-E2-17). energy_claims.py stops if the two ever differ. Was 3 mOhm (E2 estimate before F1's harness model)

nodes.title: Cold-pack resistance factor 1.5
nodes.text: Cell resistance at 10 degC = 1.5 x the 25 degC value
nodes.basis: LiPo IR roughly doubles from 25 to 0 degC; 10 degC is the bottom of params env.ambient_design_c (March-April 07:00 at RFS). Keeping packs in the car cabin removes most of it

nodes.title: Hover wind/control factor 1.10 (pessimistic)
nodes.text: Hover power in 5 m/s wind with station-keeping activity = 1.10 x calm hover power
nodes.basis: 16 deg lean at 5 m/s needs T/cos = 1.04 W; P ~ T^1.5 gives +6 %; +4 % for attitude-control activity. Replace with the twin's logged hover current

nodes.title: Mission profile timings
nodes.text: Ground 180 s at avionics power; climb and descent between 0 and 50 m AGL at 2.0 / 1.0 m/s; forward and back transitions 10 s at 1.4 / 1.3 x hover power (pessimistic 20 s each); 120 s hover; cruise to the reserve line
nodes.basis: R-TEST-ORDER transition at >= 50 m AGL; ArduPilot Q_PILOT_SPD_UP default 2.5 m/s, land 1 m/s; tailsitter pitch-over is a few seconds at high throttle (J1 evidence); doubled for the pessimistic case

nodes.title: Cruise mass scaling, circuit factor and independent cross-check model
nodes.text: The cruise power LEVEL is B1's (CL-B1-CRUISE-P / -P-PESS, level flight at the gate, avionics included). This E2 drag model (CD0 0.0593, x1.3 pessimistic, e from params, eta_prop 0.47 / 0.35, eta_motor 0.72, trim 1.05) only scales B1's power from the gate to another mass, and is reported as a cross-check. The turning (circuit) factor 1.05 multiplies B1's level-flight power
nodes.basis: K09 sizing.json CD0 build-up; REVIEW section 4 corrected efficiencies; circuits inside one RFS sub-field spend about half the time in 30 deg banks (induced drag x1.33). CR-E2-08: B1 owns cruise power; E2 follows B1's claims through the proof chain (re-run this script after every B1 re-run)

nodes.title: 4S pack candidates [name, Ah, kg, continuous A]
nodes.text: Candidate flight packs, all 4S LiPo (KV900 motors fix 4S), plus one Li-ion option
nodes.basis: Admiral 4000: Motion RC listing 386 g. 5000 and 8000: typical hard-case class masses (EST). 6500: params battery.mass_kg. Li-ion 4S2P 21700 (P45B class, 9 Ah, 90 A cont): 8 x 70 g + 60 g. Continuous A = realistic cell limit, not the label C

nodes.title: Test-day window and turnaround
nodes.text: Flying window 180 min (07:00-10:00 flight card); 20 min on the ground between sorties (log check, feet and prop inspection, pack swap, re-brief); one fully charged pack per sortie; no charging at the field
nodes.basis: R-SITE flight card; CONFIGURATION.md morning-only; RFS mains power not confirmed, and P21 forbids car charging

nodes.title: Charge profile
nodes.text: CC at min(1C, charger W / 16.8 V) to ~85 % state of charge, then CV for 20 min
nodes.basis: standard LiPo CC-CV; 1C is the maker's normal charge rate for hobby packs

nodes.title: Energy budget per phase, base case (sized mass)
nodes.equation: I = (Voc - sqrt(Voc^2 - 4 R P)) / (2 R) per phase ; Ah = I t ; P_cruise = P_B1(gate) x circuit x P_E2(m) / P_E2(gate) ; t_cruise = (C - 0.2 C - sum Ah_fixed) / I_cruise

nodes.title: Energy budget per phase, pessimistic (2.6 kg gate)
nodes.equation: as base, with m = gate, C x 0.92, R x 1.5 (10 degC), P_hover x 1.10, P_cruise = B1 pessimistic (CD0 x 1.3, eta_prop x 0.85) x circuit, 20 s transitions

nodes.title: Bus voltage at the 100 A limiter vs pack state; bracket on the thrust factor
nodes.equation: V_bus = Voc - R I_lim (limiter binds when I_unlim(V) = n I_148 (V/14.8)^2 > I_lim) ; thrust factor worst/fresh bracketed by (V_w/V_f) (thrust prop. to power) and (V_w/V_f)^(2/3) (ideal rotor at fixed current) ; old rule (V/V_tab)^2 kept for the record (unlimited motor) ; bracket margin = min(f_E1 - lower, upper - f_E1)

nodes.title: Pack self-heating over the pessimistic mission, cold and hot mornings
nodes.equation: Q = sum(I^2 R t) over phases ; dT = Q / (m c) (adiabatic, c = 1000 J/kg K) ; T_end = T_amb + dT ; cold: 10 degC, R x 1.5 ; hot: 30 degC, R x 1.0

nodes.title: Pack trade: candidates against the gate and the pessimistic mission
nodes.equation: m = m_sized - m_pack_baseline + m_cand ; pessimistic at m + (gate - m_sized) ; pass = m <= gate AND t_cruise_pess >= 5 min AND I_cont >= I_full

nodes.title: Battery failsafe thresholds for the flight controller
nodes.equation: CRT_MAH = reserve C ; LOW_MAH = CRT + Ah(back-transition + descent + 60 s return cruise + 30 s landing hover), pessimistic currents, rounded up to 100 mAh

nodes.title: Sorties per test day and charge time
nodes.equation: sorties_window = floor(window / (t_flight + t_turn)) ; sorties = min(packs, window) (D-12: 2) ; window used = sorties t_flight + (sorties - 1) t_turn ; t_charge = (0.85 - 0.20) C / I_cc + t_cv ; I_cc = min(1C, P_chg / 16.8 V)

nodes.title: E1's worst/fresh thrust factor lies inside E2's physical bracket (D-35)
nodes.how: T-E1-STAND fresh and worst-state runs: measured thrust ratio between the measured bus-voltage ratio and its 2/3 power.
nodes.note: D-35 resolved: E2 adopts E1's station model (CL-E1-SAG-FACTOR, CL-E1-TW-WORST) as the one worst-state claim. The limiter binds in every pack state, so the pack current is fixed at 100 A and thrust follows power (lower bound, thrust ~ V) or the ideal rotor (upper, ~ V^(2/3)); E1 lies between. Retires CL-E2-SAG-F-WORST and CL-E2-TW-SAG-WORST (the (V/14.8)^2 rule counted the sag twice)

nodes.title: Weigh and measure every pack on arrival
nodes.procedure: 1 g scale; calipers L x W x H incl. lead exit; one row per pack (E2-P1, E2-P2) in redesign/team/E2/pack_log.csv, then re-run this script and build_graph.py.

nodes.title: Discharge capacity test at 1C
nodes.procedure: Charger discharge mode is limited in power: discharge through the thrust stand at ~6.5 A to 3.5 V/cell under load, log mAh with the watt meter; pass >= 6.0 Ah (R-PACK-MASS).

nodes.title: Pack resistance by load step
nodes.procedure: Thrust stand, one motor: rest voltage, then 20 A step; R = dV / dI after 2 s; repeat at 10 degC (pack 1 h in a fridge, bagged). Pass <= 5 mOhm/cell at 25 degC.

nodes.title: Full-mission current log
nodes.procedure: DataFlash BAT messages; IR thermometer on pack before/after; compare row by row with the phase table.
